target: acceptance 4 — a suite with one passing case and one skipped live case still exits 0
cmd:
mkdir -p c
mkdir -p c/mixed
cat > c/mixed/m-1.json <<'CASEEOF'
{"id": "m-1", "target": "synthetic", "kind": "bash-unit", "cmd": "echo '{}'", "checks": [{"type": "exit_code", "equals": 0}]}
CASEEOF
cat > c/mixed/m-2.json <<'CASEEOF'
{"id": "m-2", "target": "synthetic", "kind": "headless-agent", "agent": "loop-reviewer", "input": {"brief": {"objective": "noop"}}, "checks": [{"type": "exit_code", "equals": 0}]}
CASEEOF
EVAL_CASES_DIR="$PWD/c" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/evals/run_eval.sh" --suite mixed >/dev/null 2>&1; printf '{"code":%s}' $?
